items.source: Parse a query into its parametrized form by identifying anonymous, named, indexed and SpEL parameters.
items.translation: 将 query 解析为其参数化形式，通过识别匿名、命名、索引以及 SpEL 参数来实现。

items.source: Query implementation to execute queries against JPA.
items.translation: 用于针对 JPA 执行查询的查询实现。

items.source: Derive a query (typically a count query) from the given query string.
items.translation: 从给定的查询字符串派生出一个查询（通常为计数查询）。

items.source: Uses of PreprocessedQuery in org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query
